items.t: UPS and FedEx both set 5.9% average increases for 2027
items.body: FedEx announced its 5.9% average on Sept. 18, 2026, effective Jan. 4, 2027. UPS announced its 5.9% on Oct. 23, 2026, effective Dec. 21, 2026, after effective dates of Dec. 22 for the 2026 increase and Dec. 29, 2019 for the 2020 increase. Both carriers averaged 4.9% for 2018 through 2021 and 6.9% for 2023, and FedEx's 5.9% is its fourth straight.

items.t: UPS 2027 surcharges rise faster than the 5.9% base increase
items.body: A Nov. 6, 2026 analysis says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than 5.9%, averaging 9.1%. UPS Ground residential goes to $7.10 from $6.50 on Dec. 21, 2026, after $6.10 to $6.50 in the 2026 increase and $4.45 to $4.85 in the 2022 increase. The Additional Handling minimum billable weight goes from 40 lb, introduced with the 2025 increase, to 50 lb, and a new origin-ZIP surcharge was listed on Oct. 23 with no amount stated.

items.t: 2026 peak add-ons exceed 2025 levels at FedEx, UPS and USPS
items.body: For Nov. 23 - Dec. 27, 2026, FedEx lists Additional Handling at $11.85 (vs $10.90 in 2025; the 2018 add-on was $3.20), Oversize at $117.25 (vs $108.50) and Ground residential at $0.80 (vs $0.65). UPS lists Large Package at $117.50 (vs $107 in 2025) and Over Maximum Limits at $590 (vs $540). The USPS peak surcharge, Oct. 4, 2026 - Jan. 17, 2027, is stacked on the temporary 8% and adds $0.50 for retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage, Zones 1-4, 0-3 lb, against $0.40 in 2025 and $0.30 in 2024.

items.t: USPS files in November again, after a year of mid-year changes
items.body: USPS filed on Nov. 12, 2026 for a 5.9% average increase effective Jan. 17, 2027, pending PRC review. It announced January changes in October for 2018, 2019 and 2020 (Oct. 6, Oct. 10, Oct. 9) and in November for each January change from 2021 on. Off-cycle changes took effect July 14, 2024 (Parcel Select +25% average) and July 13, 2025 (Ground Advantage about +7.1%), and in 2026 on April 26 (temporary 8%) and July 12 (Ground Advantage Commercial +11.8% average).

items.t: USPS adds a fuel surcharge; UPS fuel tables change five times
items.body: USPS said on Oct. 26, 2026 it will levy a weekly fuel surcharge from January 2027 on domestic Ground Advantage, Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express and Parcel Select, as a percentage of base postage. The Nov. 12 filing proposes an 11% surcharge replacing the 8% April charge; in its January 2021 change, USPS had noted no fuel surcharges. UPS changed domestic fuel tables on Jan. 5, Mar. 9, Aug. 10, Nov. 2 and Nov. 16, 2026 (announced Nov. 12; +0.50 point per band), against Apr. 29, 2024 and Mar. 10 and May 26, 2025.

UPS set $1.34/lb on U.S.-Middle East shipments effective Mar. 22, 2026, a $0.23/lb Surge Emergency Fee on most international lanes from Apr. 19, and flat export fees from May 31 (Additional Handling $8.75, Large Package $96, Over Maximum Limits $514), none with an end date. FedEx added $0.50/lb export and $0.70/lb import fees for Zone K from Mar. 5, and a Vietnam-to-U.S. fee of $0.36/lb (priority) or $0.27/lb (economy) effective Nov. 2. In 2025, the UPS international peak fees of $0.10 to $0.52 per lb ran Oct. 26, 2025 to Jan. 17, 2026, and FedEx's ran Sept. 22 to Oct. 19.
